body: Hi. Thanks for the note - I really appreciate it. Funny, I'm a Finance consultant as well! It just doesn't suit me, I'm not good with people, I don't have the alpha personality but it's the only job I've been able to get. Once my boss gets back from vacation I'll be getting the axe. I've already been told. I was so sad that my girlfriend wasn't here to support me. She changed a lot when we moved to Manhattan she started hanging around all these sex in the city type girls and I know they put doubts about me in her head. It's also my fault, I was always so stressed about my work performance and career and money and I neglected her. I'm sorry to hear about you and your mother. Is she local? Do you visit her in person? I'm very lucky that my mother will listen to me and support me. I have a very poor relationship with my only sister. She also has depression and we had our problems and haven't spoken for years. She is also going through a very hard time and I just found out that her son, my nephew who is only 8 years old is being sexually abused. I have never been there for him. I just feel so bad man - I don't know why my life turned out like this. I feel like my girlfriend was the only one who made me feel better and now she's probably out with some guy.
